purpose: Four-arm physical exploration of deferred event encoding: matrix
safety: Guarded private mount/PID/net namespace, before/after stock health and owned-directory cleanup per run
memory: Separate actual registration heap diagnostics; proc RSS/HWM remain diagnostic, not PSS or full peak acceptance.
failure_rule: Stop on collection, correctness, identity, health or cleanup failure; retain raw failed window
analysis: All per-block values and paired medians. New high-resolution own-process CPU fields are separate from old tick+reaped-child fields. Four blocks are exploratory, no formal superiority/equivalence verdict. Do not pool pre-power-loss samples.
hypothesis: Encode an object/user/ACL event only when an eligible receiver exists, as matching C does. Preserve matching, deduplication, sequence and owned queue behavior. Reduce registration work without changing retained registry representation.
retention_rule: Reject correctness failures. Report every adverse latency, own CPU, dependency/client CPU, throughput and memory direction; independently investigate new recurring regressions. This pilot cannot close the full ubusd target.
build_control: Same actual /tmp/owrt-core-release/ubusd source root, SDK, toolchain, cwd and release flags as before; previous exact-root reconstruction reproduced before bytes.
client_control: Frozen ca1a912 client and dependencies plus only process CPU clocks; same binary on all four arms. Do not pool R95/R96 measurements.
metric_directions: Lower is better except ops_per_s, which is higher-is-better. Registration ops are complete add/remove cycles.
